audit.whatIsWrong: The single most decisive interaction in this matchup was absent: Zac's knockups break Neeko's disguise.
audit.why: Inherent Glamour is broken by receiving immobilizing crowd control. Both of Zac's engage tools — Stretching Strikes and Elastic Slingshot — carry knockup. That means Zac is one of the few top laners who can out a disguised Neeko on reaction with a single ability, and it also means the Pop Blossom preparation, which the passive hides while she is disguised, gets exposed the moment the knockup lands. Nothing anywhere in the entry told the player this.
audit.corrected: Any Zac knockup strips Inherent Glamour — Q or E outs a fake ally and exposes the hidden Pop Blossom prep.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tangle-Barbs was described as a flat root with no mention that it scales up mid-flight.
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs becomes larger, faster and roots for longer if it kills an enemy or passes through a champion. The practical consequence is counter-intuitive and worth stating: standing behind a low minion she can finish makes the root that reaches you strictly worse for you, not better. Players instinctively treat minions as cover here and it is the wrong instinct.
audit.corrected: The root grows after killing a unit or passing a champion — do not eat it through your own dying minions.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tangle-Barbs is named as the tracked cooldown throughout both layers but never given a number.
audit.why: It is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s — a narrow band that barely improves with ranks, so the window after she throws it is short and consistent. Blooming Burst at 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s is the faster one and is what she actually pokes with.
Neeko is referred to with male pronouns in the full layer's tldr, winCon and phases[1].why. Corrected where the string was uniquely addressable.
